name: Lime and Mascarpone Cheesecake
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 500 g mascarpone cheese or plain cream cheese
200 g ginger nut biscuits, crushed or ground in a food processor

steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan and add the biscuit crumbs. Press firmly into a 20 cm diameter loose-bottomed pan and put aside.
Put the mascarpone in a bowl and beat until firm.
Add the juice of 3 of the limes and the grated or zested rind of all 4 into the cheese. Stir, adding icing sugar to taste.
Spread the cheese mixture over the biscuit base and chill for an hour or so before serving.

culture.text: Cheesecake is a dessert made with a soft fresh cheese, and sugar, with either eggs or cream depending if it is to be baked or not. It may have a crust or base made from crushed cookies, digestive biscuits, graham crackers, pastry, or sometimes sponge cake. Cheesecake is known for its rich, creamy flavor and smooth texture. It may be baked or unbaked and is usually served chilled.
